# alchemy-viz

`alchemy-viz-0.1.5.tgz` is a local npm package for the browser half of alchemy-viz.
It uses the upstream manifest and unmodified JavaScript bundle, schema, and MIT
license from the [0.1.5 release](https://pypi.org/project/alchemy-viz/0.1.5/),
with payload types from the [matching source tag](https://github.com/omsf/alchemy-viz/tree/v0.1.5).
This pins the renderer to the same release as the backend's JSON serializer while
the registry package is unavailable.
